data.title: AI-Generated Document Detection in Verification
data.description: Detects indicators of AI-generated or synthetically created identity documents submitted during verification workflows. Flags include metadata anomalies (missing EXIF data, uniform noise patterns), font rendering inconsistencies, micro-printing irregularities, and GAN-generated portrait artifacts such as asymmetric earrings or irregular hair boundaries.

detection.condition: selection and (filter_metadata or filter_visual or filter_font)

falsepositives: Heavily compressed or photocopied documents with degraded visual quality
Older documents scanned with consumer-grade scanners losing metadata
Legitimately renewed documents with updated security features not yet in template database
